lines.meet: Étienne Gagnon, from Montréal. I drove a Zamboni back home, and up here I make ice on purpose, which is more fun.
lines.meet_neighbour: Hey, you're staying at the Annex too! Look for the guy flooding a rink on a cloud, that's me.
lines.ask_home: So where's home for you, eh? I'm guessing nowhere with proper winters.
lines.ask_work: What kept the lights on for you, back home? I'm curious, eh.
lines.answer_home: Montréal, in Québec, in Hochelaga, out east. Winters that hurt, bagels hot out of the oven at midnight, and hockey everywhere.
lines.answer_work: I drove the Zamboni at a rink for ten years, and I coached a peewee team that never won a game. Best job in the world.
lines.chat_food: Poutine at two in the morning after a game, the gravy too hot and the curds squeaking. You haven't lived, eh.
lines.chat_sleep: Out cold the moment I'm horizontal, and up at five to flood the ice. Rink hours never leave you.
lines.chat_missing: The rink at six in the morning, flooding it slow and even, before anyone comes in. Just me and the hum of the boards.
lines.chat_here: I woke up in a snowdrift on a sky island and figured I was home, until I looked over the edge. Big surprise, eh.
lines.tease_quiet: Goalie energy, {name}. Never say a word, always in position.
lines.tease_talker: You'd make a great colour commentator, {name}. You never run out of things to say.
lines.tease_careful: You'd sharpen your skates three times before a game, {name}. My kind of player.
lines.tease_bold: You'd skate straight at the biggest defenceman on the ice, {name}. I love it, but wear a helmet.
lines.tease_any: I'd put you on my peewee team, {name}. Fair warning, we never won a game.
lines.take_it_kindly: Okay, okay, fair, {name}. My mémère said the same thing.
lines.bristle: Hey, easy there, {name}. I wrecked my knee at nineteen, and that's not a joke for me.
lines.needle_quiet: Call it out when something's coming, eh. That's how you avoid a hit.
lines.needle_talker: Little quieter, eh? You're calling every play out loud.
lines.needle_careful: At some point you've got to shoot the puck, you can't just stickhandle forever.
lines.needle_bold: You keep going end to end on your own, and you're gonna get flattened.
lines.needle_any: You never pass, eh. It's a team game, even out here.
lines.bite_back: I've frozen everything that came at us since the first day. Don't tell me I'm not pulling my weight.
lines.hurt: Okay, that stung, not gonna lie. I'm gonna go skate it off.
lines.laugh_off: I've been chirped by nine-year-olds who were better at it than you. Nice try, though.
lines.apologise: Désolé, that was a cheap shot. I was tired and cranky, and that's on me.
lines.double_down: Nah, it stands. Somebody had to call the penalty.
lines.confide: {name}, I had a shot at playing properly, until I wrecked my knee at nineteen. The Zamboni was the closest I could get after.
lines.listen: Go ahead, {name}. I'm listening, and it stays in the room.
lines.look_out: Stay behind me, {name}, I'll freeze it before it gets close.
lines.accept: Your call, coach {name}. I'll play it your way.
lines.deflect: Just a bruise, {name}, I've taken worse into the boards. Check on the others.
lines.check_in: You took a hit there, {name}. Sit down a second, I want a look at it.
lines.blame: Somebody went offside and the whole play fell apart.
lines.thank: You saved my bacon there, mon ami. First round's on me, eh.
lines.brush_off: No problem, that's what linemates are for.
lines.worry: Hey, hey, {name}, don't go anywhere, eh. You're okay, I've got you.
lines.handed_down: Here, mon ami, this one's yours. Take it back.
lines.hand_fine: Sure, take it, no problem. I wore a toque and a Zamboni jacket for ten years.
lines.hand_sulk: Didn't ask the Zamboni guy, eh. That's fine by me.
lines.turn_friendly: You'd be on my line any day, {name}. That's the highest compliment I've got.
lines.turn_friends: I'd take a puck to the face for you, {name}, and I've done it, so I mean it.
lines.turn_grating: We don't gel, eh, not really. That's okay, we can still play the same game.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still freeze anything coming at you. Just don't expect a handshake after.
lines.make_up: Hey, {name}, let's drop it, eh. Shake hands at centre ice?
lines.defend: Whoa, back off, that's a bad call. {name} played it perfect.
lines.friend_left: The Annex is way too quiet with {name} gone, and the rink feels empty.
lines.friend_back: {name}, you're here again! Now we've got a full line.
lines.common_sport: You played something, eh? You've got that look, like you know how to take a hit.
lines.common_snow: You know real winter, don't you? Anybody who's shovelled a driveway at six in the morning has that look.
lines.common_teacher: You've coached or taught, I can tell. You watch people learn things like it matters to you.
